visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static illustration of a female anime warrior with blonde hair and ornate white and orange armor. She holds a large flaming sword. In the background, a dark, cloudy sky frames a skeletal, dragon-like creature. Bold text overlays occupy the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A rapid montage of game character illustrations follows. It features two futuristic figures with glowing blue and pink digital effects, a golden-armored woman with a solar crown, and two characters from the anime 'Demon Slayer' in a forest setting. The transitions are fast and sharp. (3) The scene shifts to 3D gameplay in a lush, green forest area. A female character performs basic attacks, swinging her sword and creating vibrant orange and red circular energy slashes. The environment includes stone structures, thick grass, and a top-down camera perspective. (4) The character showcases a specific skill, spinning in place to generate a large, glowing orange and yellow energy circle on the ground. The lighting is bright and high-contrast, emphasizing the intricate patterns within the magical field as she moves across the terrain. (5) During the second skill demonstration, the character dashes forward. A massive, stylized golden dragon head is summoned, breathing a linear path of fire across the screen. Detailed particle effects of embers and golden light fill the frame during this high-action sequence. (6) The ultimate skill is showcased as the character leaps into the air. A massive pillar of golden light strikes the ground, and a giant, translucent golden dragon swirls around the impact area. The visual density is high, with glowing particles and intense lighting effects. (7) The video concludes with a screen recording of a Shopee shop page. It displays various products like white wireless headphones and a black cross-shaped electronic item. The shop name 'Qi 黃帝的後花園' is visible at the top with a lion logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice begins the narration with an enthusiastic, professional tone. The background music is a fast-paced electronic dance track (128 BPM) featuring bright synthesizer leads and a driving kick drum. There is no background noise, resulting in a very clean studio-quality recording. (2) Every few seconds, sharp "whoosh" and "metallic impact" sound effects occur, synchronized with visual cuts. The speaker's pitch and arousal levels increase significantly as he makes grandiose claims about the quality of the game skin. The electronic music provides a constant, high-energy foundation throughout. (3) As the gameplay demonstration begins, a series of percussive "clink" and "slash" SFX are layered over the music. The speaker maintains a fast speech rate, describing the animations in detail. The mix is well-balanced, with the voice clearly sitting above the music and effects. (4) A heavy, low-frequency "thud" and "energy surge" SFX mark the showcase of the character's first skill. The speaker's volume swells, expressing high excitement. The BGM continues with a steady rhythmic pulse, maintaining the video's fast-paced momentum without any pauses or breaks. (5) During the second skill showcase, a distinct "roar" sound effect and a sustained "fire whoosh" are heard. The speaker's intonation becomes highly dynamic, using exaggerated pitch contours to emphasize the "ridiculous" nature of the visuals. The sound design is dense and highly technical. (6) A cinematic "impact boom" and "glimmering chime" SFX accompany the ultimate skill. The speaker's voice reaches its highest volume and arousal, bordering on shouting. The music's spectral brightness increases during this highlight, creating a powerful auditory peak for the viewer. (7) The audio transitions to a more casual, informative tone as the speaker discusses the pricing model. A subtle "UI click" sound effect is used. The music continues at the same tempo, while the vocal delivery becomes more relaxed but remains clear and enunciated. (8) In the final phase, the speaker delivers a promotional call to action. The music maintains its energy until the very end. A final "notification chime" SFX marks the appearance of social media info. The overall signal-to-noise ratio remains excellent with no technical distortions.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Skill Showcase -> Pricing Info -> Promotional CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to generate hype for a new 'Butterfly' skin in the game Arena of Valor by showcasing its visually impressive special effects (basic attacks, skills, ultimate). It emphasizes the value proposition (potentially free but requiring awakening) to engage the audience and concludes with a giveaway and shop promotion to drive traffic to the creator's social media and e-commerce store.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly mentions his Shopee store and specific products like headphones and power banks at the end of the video, offering a giveaway for engagement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-retention gaming content style using rapid editing and enthusiastic voiceover. Effectively uses a niche gaming audience to promote an unrelated e-commerce shop.
